newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Bossi faces trial for attack on rightists.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Bossi faces trial for attack on rightists.

text.p: The outspoken leader of Italy's secessionist Northern League party was sent for trial on Wednesday for urging supporters to hunt down voters of the far-right National Alliance, a court official said.
League leader Umberto Bossi made the appeal at a rally near this northern Italian town in 1995.

"If you know of someone who voted for the National Alliance, take down their names. I'm not joking about this. At the right moment, if its necessary, the League will go from house to house and take them," he said.
Examining judge Davide Rosati decided that Bossi should face charges of inciting people to break the law. The trial was set to start on July 2.
